 Spill the Tea, Add to Cart: How Kris Aquino Took Over Shopee Live for the 11.11 Sale
 By Nicole Tesorero - November 19, 2026 0 130 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 The holidays are arriving early, and Kris Aquino is giving Filipino shoppers plenty of reasons to celebrate. On November 10 and 11, the Queen of All Media steps into the spotlight on Shopee Live for the Kris Aquino Live Showcase, bringing her trademark wit, candid storytelling, and unmistakable charm to one of the year’s biggest online shopping events.
 Kicking off at 12:00 NN on November 10, the special broadcast offers longtime fans a fresh dose of Kris’s sharp humor and spontaneous reactions as she reconnects with viewers, shares personal picks, and teams up with familiar guests.
 Heartwarming Kwentuhan and Kulitan with Kris and Bimby 
 A major highlight of the event is a dedicated two-hour segment featuring Kris alongside her son, Bimby, marking another welcome on-screen reunion for the beloved mother-son pair.
 Celebrated for their effortless chemistry and genuine bond, Kris and Bimby will bring their signature banter to Shopee Live as they swap stories, browse unique finds, and hunt for holiday gift ideas together. Viewers can expect the same unscripted humor and playful teasing that have long endeared the duo to Filipino audiences.
 Style Spotlight with Mimiyuuuh and Nicole Andersson 
 Adding even more flair to the stream, viral content creator Mimiyuuuh and lifestyle personality Nicole Andersson will make special guest appearances to share their distinct fashion perspectives.
 Together, the pair will showcase the newest collection from BASH, giving style-conscious viewers an up-close look at the brand’s latest holiday-ready pieces. Blending Mimiyuuuh’s vibrant energy with Nicole’s polished aesthetic, the segment promises fresh wardrobe inspiration—though shoppers will need to act fast, as the new BASH line drops in limited quantities.
 Royal-Worthy 11.11 Deals and Exclusives 
 True to form, Kris is arriving with plenty of treats for viewers. The Kris Aquino Live Showcase will roll out curated product listings, special bundles, livestream-exclusive markdowns, new releases, and Shopee VIP vouchers to help shoppers get a jump on their holiday gift lists.
 Spanning beauty, fashion, gadgets, home goods, and everyday essentials, the event will feature deals from top brands including:
 • Samsung, Honor, Anker, and GameXtreme
 • Unilever, P&G, Abbott, Nutriasia, and Nestlé
 • Bash, Sasa HK, Chef’s Classics, and Haier
 Whether you’re hunting for holiday bargains, looking for gift inspiration, or simply tuning in for Kris’s personal recommendations, catching the stream early will be key to snagging time-limited offers.
 Catch the Kris Aquino Live Showcase 
 Between Kris and Bimby’s much-anticipated reunion, stylish segments with Mimiyuuuh and Nicole Andersson, and a packed roster of exclusive discounts, Shopee’s 11.11 celebration is shaping up to be an entertaining, deal-filled event you won’t want to miss.
 Catch the Kris Aquino Live Showcase on November 10-11, 2026, exclusively on Shopee Live. Set your reminder and tune in early at shopee.ph/ShopeeLiveWithKrisAquino .
